apps.name: Drift
apps.title: Drift: Sleep Sounds and White Noise App for iPhone
apps.description: Drift is a free sleep sounds app for iPhone with white noise, rain, ocean and fan sounds, a fade out sleep timer and offline playback.
apps.answer: Drift is a free white noise and sleep sounds app for iPhone and iPad that works offline, even on a plane: white noise, rain, ocean, stream and fan are free, with a sleep timer and sound that keeps playing with the screen locked. It is a free alternative to Calm for masking snoring or traffic, and Premium at $1.99 a month, with a free first week, adds thunder, forest, night, fire, wind and cafe and removes ads.
apps.pricing: Free with five sounds and ads. Premium is $1.99 a month and unlocks all eleven sounds with no ads; eligible new subscribers get a free week. Premium sounds can be previewed for 30 seconds.
bestFor: falling asleep faster with white noise or rain
masking snoring, traffic or noisy neighbors
sleeping on planes or anywhere without signal
features: Eleven sleep sounds, including a deep white noise, rain, ocean, stream and fan
Sleep timer of 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours, with an optional wind down that fades the sound as the timer ends
Keeps playing with the screen locked
Works offline, every sound ships in the app
Sleep mode keeps the screen dark
30 second previews of every Premium sound
No account needed
faq: Is Drift free?
Yes. White noise, rain, ocean, stream and fan are free. Premium is $1.99 a month, unlocks six more sounds and removes ads, and eligible new subscribers get a free week.
Does Drift work without internet?
Yes. Every sound is stored inside the app, so it plays on a plane, in a cabin or with your phone in airplane mode.
Will Drift keep playing when my screen locks?
Yes. Drift uses background audio, so sound keeps going with the phone locked, all night or until the sleep timer fades it out.
Which sound is best for sleep?

Steady sounds like white noise and fan are best for masking sharp noises such as snoring or traffic. Rain, ocean and stream suit people who find pure noise harsh. Drift lets you preview every sound, so try a few for a night each.
Can I set a sleep timer?
Yes. Pick 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours. Turn on wind down and the sound fades out as the timer ends instead of stopping abruptly.
Does Drift work offline on a plane?
Yes. Every sound ships inside the app, so nothing needs downloading before you fly. Test it once in airplane mode, set the timer and lock the screen.

apps.name: SignSnap
apps.title: SignSnap: Sign PDF Documents on iPhone, No Account
apps.description: SignSnap lets you scan or import a PDF, add your signature and send it from your iPhone. No account and no uploads. First 2 documents free.
apps.answer: SignSnap is a free iPhone and iPad app to sign a PDF or scan and sign a paper form, such as a lease, offer letter or permission slip, with no account and no uploads: draw or type your signature, place it on the line, stamp the date and share the signed PDF. It is a simple alternative to DocuSign when you only need to sign one document yourself.
apps.pricing: Free for the first 2 signed documents, then one rewarded ad unlocks one more signing. Premium is weekly, monthly or yearly with no ads and no limit, with a free week for new subscribers.
bestFor: signing a PDF on iPhone for free
signing one document without a DocuSign account
signing a lease, offer letter or permission slip from a phone
people who do not want to make an account or upload documents to a cloud service
replacing print, sign and scan
features: Draw or type your signature in a script font
Camera scanner with automatic edge detection, one page at a time
Import PDFs from the Files app or Photos
Drag the signature onto the line, pinch to resize, and stamp the date beside it
Save a signature and initials for next time
Share a PDF to Mail, Messages or AirDrop
No account and no cloud uploads
faq: How do I sign a PDF on my iPhone with SignSnap?
Import the PDF from the Files app (save an email attachment to Files first) or scan the paper with the camera, add your saved signature, drag it onto the line and tap share to send the signed PDF.
Do I need an account?
No. SignSnap works without an account, and documents stay on your iPhone instead of being uploaded.
Is SignSnap a free alternative to DocuSign?

For signing a document yourself, yes: the first 2 signed documents are free, then one short ad unlocks one more signing. DocuSign is built for sending documents to other people to sign, which SignSnap does not do.
Is SignSnap free?
Your first 2 signed documents are free, and after that you can watch one short ad to unlock one more signing. Premium is weekly, monthly or yearly with no limit, and new subscribers get a free week.
Can I type my signature instead of drawing it?
Yes. Draw it with your finger or type your name and pick a script font.

apps.name: CelebriDay
apps.title: CelebriDay: What Holiday Is It Today? App for iPhone
apps.description: CelebriDay tells you what national day it is today, with a morning notification, a fun fact and a share card for 700 plus holidays.
apps.answer: CelebriDay is an iPhone and iPad app that tells you what national day it is today, every day of the year: a morning notification names today's holiday, and each of its 700 plus observances, from National Pizza Day to World Emoji Day, has a fun fact and a card to share on social media. Today and tomorrow are free in the app, and a free list of national days by month, with every date checked, is on the web at graysmithlabs.com/holidays/.
apps.pricing: Free with ads: today and tomorrow, every holiday's fun fact, sharing and the 8 AM daily note. Premium, monthly or yearly with a free week for new subscribers, opens every other day of the calendar, favorites, choosing the note time and removes ads.
bestFor: finding out what national day it is today
teachers, offices and teams looking for fun national days to celebrate at work
social media managers planning posts around national days
daily conversation starters and fun facts
features: Today and tomorrow free, with every holiday and fun fact
Morning notification with today's holiday
Share cards for every holiday
A calendar of the whole year (Premium beyond tomorrow)
Favorites (Premium)
Choose when the daily note arrives (Premium)
Free national day lists by month on graysmithlabs.com/holidays/
faq: What national day is it today?

The today page at graysmithlabs.com/holidays/ lists every verified observance for today, and the CelebriDay app names it in a notification each morning, with a fun fact and a share card inside the app.
Are the holidays in CelebriDay real?

Every observance on the website is checked against a public source before it is published, and moving holidays are recalculated each year. The app uses the same list; its dates were checked in October 2026 and the few that were wrong were corrected.
Is CelebriDay free?

Yes. Today and tomorrow are free with ads, including the fun facts, sharing and the morning note at 8 AM. Premium, monthly or yearly with a free week to try it, opens the whole calendar and favorites, lets you pick when the note arrives and removes ads.
Can I use it to plan social media posts?
Yes. Every holiday has a card you can share to Instagram, Messages or anywhere else, and the month pages on graysmithlabs.com/holidays/ list every national day ahead for free.

The free plan gives five affirmations a day, the whole Confidence category and a preview of every other category, plus a daily reminder, streak milestones and your own written affirmations. Premium adds every category with no daily limit, home and lock screen widgets, recordings in your own voice and no ads.

positive affirmations on the lock screen
morning routines and gratitude practice
people who want a low cost affirmation app

Say your first affirmation in under a minute during setup

faq: Is SayBright free?

Premium is $0.99 a month or $9.99 a year with a free week first for eligible new subscribers, and opens every category with no daily limit, widgets, voice recordings and no ads.
Can I put affirmations on my lock screen?

Can I write my own affirmations?

How do streaks work?
Open your daily affirmation each day to build a streak, with celebrations at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.
How many affirmations does SayBright have?
340 affirmations in ten categories: Confidence, Gratitude, Morning Energy, Self Love, Career Growth, Relationships, Health and Body, Wealth and Abundance, Calm and Anxiety Relief, and Creativity.

apps.name: BlitzTap
apps.title: BlitzTap: Reaction Time and Reflex Game for iPhone
apps.description: BlitzTap is a free reaction time game for iPhone: tap the matching shape before the clock runs out, with four tiers and streak multipliers.
apps.answer: BlitzTap is a free iPhone and iPad reflex game: a target shape appears, and you tap its match in a grid before the timer runs out. Four tiers shrink the timer to about a second, streaks multiply your score, and there are no energy systems or pay to win. One purchase removes ads.
apps.pricing: Free with ads. A one time purchase removes ads. No subscription.
bestFor: testing and training reaction time
quick games to play in a minute or two
a free game with no energy timers or pay to win
focus and visual search practice
features: Four difficulty tiers
Streak multipliers up to 5x
Haptics and sound on every hit
Personal bests tracked
Reduce Motion and silent switch support
No energy systems, no wait timers
faq: Is BlitzTap free?
Yes. It is free with ads, and a single one time purchase removes them. There is no subscription and nothing pay to win.
Does BlitzTap improve reaction time?
It trains quick visual matching under time pressure and tracks your best scores, so you can see yourself get faster. It is a game, not a medical or cognitive test.

apps.name: TubTender
apps.title: TubTender: Hot Tub Water Test and Chemical Calculator
apps.description: Hot tub chemical calculator for iPhone: tap your test strip colors and TubTender shows how much of your own bottles to add, in order, and when to soak.
apps.answer: TubTender is a hot tub water care and chemical calculator app for iPhone, for bromine or chlorine tubs: tap the colors on your test strip, scan the labels of the chemicals you own, and it shows how much of each to add for your tub size, in the right order, with a countdown until the water is safe to soak. The test and dose plan is free with no account, and version 1.0 is in App Review.
apps.pricing: Free test, dose plan, reminders, the cloudy and foamy water guides and your last 5 tests. Premium monthly or yearly adds trend charts, full history and every fix it guide, with a free week to try it.
bestFor: new hot tub owners who do not know how much chemical to add
bromine or chlorine hot tubs
fixing cloudy, foamy or smelly hot tub water
keeping a test schedule
features: Tap the strip colors instead of typing numbers
Scan chemical bottle labels to get their strength
Exact amounts for your tub size and products
Steps in the right order with wait times
Safe to soak verdict and countdown
No account, data stays on the iPhone
Free step by step guides for cloudy and foamy water
faq: Is there an app that reads hot tub test strips?
TubTender reads your strip when you tap the color that matches each pad, so it works with any common spa strip. The camera is used to read the strength on your chemical bottle labels.
How does TubTender work out how much to add?
It uses your tub size, your readings and the strength printed on each product you own, and works out pH and alkalinity together. Always follow the product label as well.
Does TubTender work with bromine and chlorine?
Yes. Pick your sanitizer once and every dose plan, target range and shock step follows it.
Can TubTender help with cloudy or foamy hot tub water?
Yes. Free step by step guides cover cloudy and foamy water. Premium adds guides for smelly, green, itchy and scaly water.
Is TubTender free?
Testing, the dose plan, reminders and your last 5 tests are free. Premium, monthly or yearly with a free week, adds trends, full history and every guide.
Can I download TubTender now?
Version 1.0 is in App Review. Until it is live, the free hot tub chemical calculator on graysmithlabs.com runs the same engine in the browser.

services.title: App development services for iOS, Android and web | Graysmith Labs
services.description: Graysmith Labs builds iOS, Android, Expo and web apps, backends and AI features, plus a fixed price app audit. Free scoping call, then a fixed quote.
services.answer: Graysmith Labs is a founder led software studio in Centennial, Colorado that designs and builds iOS and Android apps (React Native and Expo, or Swift), web apps, backends and AI features for companies, takes apps through App Store review and launch, and offers a fixed price app audit. Every project starts with a free scoping call, then a written plan and a fixed quote; contract engineering is billed weekly or monthly. Proof is public: the studio publishes its own iPhone apps (Drift, SignSnap, CelebriDay, SayBright, BlitzTap, with TubTender in App Review) and built the Valentine Tide storefront.
offers: One React Native and Expo codebase for both stores, or native Swift, through App Store review and launch.
Web apps and sites from a marketing page to a full product with accounts, payments and dashboards.
APIs, webhooks, background jobs and serverless infrastructure.
Assistants, search, summaries, on device features and agents inside a product or its operations.
Paywalls, free trials, RevenueCat entitlements and AdMob with App Tracking Transparency.
A senior engineer inside a client team on weekly or monthly terms.
A review of an app, its codebase and its App Store listing with a written report of what to fix first.
faq: What does Graysmith Labs build?

iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo or native Swift, web apps and sites, backends and serverless APIs, and AI features and automation. It also sets up subscriptions with RevenueCat, payments with Stripe and ads with AdMob, and takes apps through App Store review.
How much does an app cost?
It depends on scope, so there are no list prices. After a free scoping call you get a written plan and a fixed quote for a defined build. Contract engineering is billed at a weekly or monthly rate.
What is the fixed price app audit?

A short review of your app, codebase and App Store listing, priced before it starts. It covers App Review risks, subscriptions and the paywall, ads and privacy, the listing and search, and the code and build setup, and ends with a written report of what to fix first.
Can you take over an existing React Native or Expo app?
Yes. Contract engineering is built for that: we join your repos, tools and review process, and an audit is a good first step to see where the app stands.
Who owns the code?
You do. Once the work is paid for, the code, designs and accounts belong to your company, and everything is documented so any engineer can pick it up.
How do I start?
Email ramsey@graysmithlabs.com with what you are building, who it is for and when you need it. The reply sets up the free scoping call.
